profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a publicly traded company headquartered in Tel Aviv that trades under the ticker WIX and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001576789. Its own site presents it as a website builder: the company describes a free, easy-to-use builder offering more than 2,000 templates, built-in AI tools, and a custom domain. It also says users can sell products, services, and memberships from a single dashboard with no plugins required.

On the AI side, the site's claims are limited to built-in AI tools within the builder and what it calls specialized AI agents meant to support business growth. The company does not name individual AI products on the material available, and no AI products are recorded for it here. There is no litigation, no MCP server presence, and no other registry or patent facts on file for Wix beyond its corporate and SEC identifiers.
